plain: To wipe out completely, leaving no trace.

webster.text: To efface; to erase or blot out any thing written; or to efface any thing engraved.

example.quote: This would totally obliterate the federal features of the Constitution.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. AMES, January 19, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
